audience: support and sales teams that text customers from a shared Heymarket inbox

useCases.title: Check unread conversations in the team inboxes
useCases.text: List the team inboxes, then list their unread conversations. Open one conversation to see its details.

useCases.title: Find a contact and read the message history
useCases.text: Search contacts by phone number or email address. Read the contact, then the message history with that number in one inbox.

useCases.title: Review the latest messages across the team
useCases.text: List the team's messages, newest first. The history covers the last 12 months.

useCases.title: Browse contact lists, tags and saved templates
useCases.text: List the contact lists and the contact tags of the team. List the saved message templates to reuse their wording.

useCases.title: Send one text from an inbox to a customer
useCases.text: Send one SMS or MMS from an inbox to a phone number or an existing chat. A sent message cannot be recalled, so send only to people who consented.
